opening.argument: The video walks streamers through a specific setup task: connect PayPal in Streamlabs donation settings, then place the donation page address in a Twitch channel panel. Its stated purpose is to show how to set up donations on streaming platforms, and the visible Streamlabs screens match that instruction. The resulting payment path is presented as optional audience support through a displayed donation link. Nothing in the cited material asks viewers to invest, surrender credentials, or expect a guaranteed return; the focus remains on configuring a routine creator-support feature.

citations.quote: Need to know how to set up donations on streaming platforms like Twitch, YouTube, and Mixer? In this video right here, I got you covered.
Now that we're at our Streamlabs dashboards, click on the donation settings. Click on the PayPal icon to connect your PayPal account to Streamlabs.
Copy this address and put it into your Twitch channel. Under your panels.
